_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-24 09:41:35Z)**_

Root cause plain. Line 7 add NOT NULL on `created_by_id` no backfill. Comment claim "no ticket data predates feature" wrong for your DB — table already got rows, so ALTER fails: `column "created_by_id" of relation "tickets" contains null values`.

Fix option: backfill before NOT NULL constraint, or make nullable if legit.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-09-24 09:41:42Z)**_

Cause: your local DB got ticket rows before V4 ran (test/dev usage). Migration comment assumes fresh DB always — false here.

Two fixes:

**A. Reset local dev DB** (if data disposable): drop DB / `flyway clean` then rerun. Fast, matches migration's stated assumption.

**B. Fix migration** to backfill `created_by_id` with a system user before NOT NULL, so it works on any existing data too.

No maven flyway plugin, only core dependency. Repair via SQL direct, simplest:

```sql
DELETE FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version = '4' AND success = false;
```
